info.title: ReachHunt API
info.description:
The ReachHunt API gives your own apps and scripts programmatic access to your workspace: accounts, campaigns, lead lists, conversations, messages, tags and statuses.

Send your API key in the `Authorization` header: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`. The key decides the workspace, so no path or parameter names one.

Every response has the same envelope: `{ "status": true, "data": ..., "error": null }`.

get.description: Returns the one-to-one conversations in your workspace, across every connected account or for one. Open conversations are returned unless you change `scope`. Paged with a cursor.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: Only conversations of this connected account. Leave it out for all accounts.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text to look for in the person's name, in their handle, and in the last message.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description:
Which conversations to return.

- `all`: open conversations.
- `unread`: open conversations with unread messages.
- `needs_reply`: open conversations where the other person wrote last.
- `pending`: open conversations where you wrote last.
- `closed`: closed conversations.
- `any`: open and closed. Defaults to `all`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order by the time of the last message. Defaults to `newest`.

parameters.name: tagId
parameters.description: Only conversations with this tag. Repeat the parameter to match several tags.

parameters.name: statusId
parameters.description: Only conversations in this status. Repeat the parameter to match several statuses.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to `50`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page. A cursor only works with the filters it was issued for.

200.description: OK. Check `status`: errors the API handles itself also return 200.

total.description: How many conversations match, across all pages.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` to read the next page. `null` on the last page.

syncedAt.description: When the conversations were last refreshed from X and LinkedIn, in ISO 8601 UTC. `null` until a refresh has finished.

sources.description: Where each account is in loading its conversations.

walk.description: How far the account's history has been loaded.

lastMessage.text: Thanks, sounds good. Send the details over.
